name: Sanae Takaichi
role: Prime minister of Japan (2025–present), former economic security and internal affairs minister
summary: Takaichi combines strategic public investment and technological development with stronger defense and the US alliance. Her program supports nuclear expansion, free trade and multilateral cooperation while retaining conservative marriage and imperial-succession policies.

Supportive but not a stated maximal localism.

claude-sonnet-5-5 notes: Second independent pass using Japanese-language sources: official website philosophy page, National Diet minutes (kokkai.ndl.go.jp API) and Japanese Wikipedia (as reference for dated quotations). Diet answers given as minister or PM are treated as her own words where she speaks in the first person, but many reflect government policy so confidence is capped at medium unless she spoke for herself. Only statements whose exact wording her record addresses are answered; broader constitutional, defence and economy themes covered in earlier pass are not repeated here beyond a few overlaps.
